Frequently Asked Questions

What are the most popular Yamaha bikes and Scooters models available in Nepal?

The most popular models include Yamaha FZ, Yamaha R15, Yamaha MT-15, and Yamaha RAY ZR Hybrid.

What is the best features of Yamaha motorbikes in Nepal that makes it popular?

Yamaha motorbikes are best known for its Mileage, Performance and Pioneers of Fi Technologies in Nepal.

Where can I buy genuine Yamaha bikes in Nepal?

You can buy genuine Yamaha bikes from authorized dealers and Yamaha Showrooms in Nepal located in different cities.

What is the average mileage Yamaha bikes and scooters gives in roads of Nepal?

Yamaha bikes are known for their fuel efficiency with models like the Yamaha FZ and Ray ZR delivering around 45-58 km/liter on average.

Are there any ongoing discounts of Offer on Yamaha bikes in Nepal?

Promotions and discounts are frequently offered during festive seasons and special events and Seasons. Check with local dealers or the official Yamaha Nepal website for current offers.
